llm.summary: This skill provides a mortgage disclosure checklist without executable code, credential access, or instructions to change accounts or systems.

dimensions.detail: Parent workflows and automated alerts are referenced but not implemented; no broad file or account access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown, with no installer, dependencies, or remote execution instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions stay within checklist preparation and verification; no unrelated actions or authority overrides appear.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Record retention concerns disclosure evidence; no background workers, system persistence, or elevated privileges are specified.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Disclosure timing checks and evidence retention fit the stated mortgage checklist purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this as a checklist aid and verify current requirements with authoritative guidance. Share only necessary borrower information. Referenced automation and parent workflows are not included.
